statements.text: Descending interoceptive predictions act as reference points for autonomic reflexes, so bodily states are regulated by fulfilling predictions, as motor reflexes fulfill proprioceptive predictions.

sources.quote: interoceptive prediction errors can be suppressed both by modifying predictions and by transcribing these predictions into reference points for autonomic reflexes that regulate physiological homeostasis
bodily states are regulated by autonomic reflexes that are enslaved by descending predictions from deep generative models of our internal and external milieu
